candidate_sentences.text: For the nine months ended 30 September 2025, the AB KN Energies Group reported revenue from contracts with customers of EUR 76,664 thousand, representing an increase compared to EUR 67,977 thousand for the same period in 2024.

For the company alone, revenue from contracts with customers reached EUR 72,848 thousand for the nine months of 2025 compared to EUR 65,009 thousand in 2024, gross profit was EUR 29,058 thousand compared to EUR 26,957 thousand, operating profit was EUR 19,277 thousand compared to EUR 17,408 thousand, and profit for the period was EUR 11,613 thousand compared to EUR 10,702 thousand.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operating profit increased to EUR 21.3 million (2025) from EUR 18.9 million (2024), driven by higher LNG regasification volumes, full terminal operational capacity (vs. 1.5 months downtime in 2024), and client capacity bonuses; partially offset by reduced LNG security supplement income due to regulatory excess return repayments.

candidate_sentences.text: Operating profit rose to EUR 21,282 thousand from EUR 18,942 thousand.

Revenue growth in liquefied natural gas terminal activities was driven by the fact that the terminal was fully operational during the first nine months of 2025, whereas in the comparable period of 2024 it was out of operation for one and a half months due to dry-dock repair works.
Additional contributing factors included higher LNG regasification volumes and bonuses paid by LNGT clients for booked capacity.

These increases occurred despite offsetting factors, such as a reduction in LNG security supplement income caused by the proportionally recognized repayment of excess returns from regulated activities during 2022 through 2023, and lower payments collected from clients for unused allocated capacities.

verified_key_information_units.information: Segment performance: Liquid Energy Terminals (LET) revenue was EUR 21.9 million (2025 vs EUR 21.1 million), LNG Terminal (LNGT) revenue rose to EUR 45.6 million (vs EUR 38.4 million), and commercial LNG activities revenue increased to EUR 9.2 million (vs EUR 8.5 million).
Net cash generated from operating activities surged to EUR 76.3 million in 2025 from EUR 35.6 million in 2024, primarily due to higher net profit and net favorable working capital changes.

Group borrowings decreased slightly to EUR 294.4 million (2025) from EUR 301.4 million (2024), while lease liabilities remained stable at approximately EUR 24 million. Cash and cash equivalents increased significantly to EUR 54.4 million from EUR 17.2 million.
